leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize React state to manage a dynamic list of items
Implement a scroll event listener to detect when users reach the bottom of the page
Construct a function that fetches and appends new data to the existing list
Configure conditional rendering to display a loading indicator during data retrieval
Apply the useEffect hook to handle side effects related to scroll events
Manipulate the DOM to reset scroll position and prevent duplicate API calls
Integrate error handling for failed data fetch attempts
